scientific_integrity: Complete claim confined to one rank-four classification; finite checks are not substituted for the uniform character-sum argument. No claim of priority for the known three-extension theorem.
scientific_limitations: Rank-four only, pure undirected adjacency/equality language, finite Paley graphs only. The q>=29 three-extension threshold is known from Ananchuen--Caccetta (1993), not a new assertion. Small-field arithmetic is computationally rechecked but independent scientific audit has not been performed. Exact publication day for earlier 1981 and 1993 background articles was not established; 2005-08-30 is the verified public date of the selected archival lead source. Full 1993 paper unavailable; residual overlap risk remains.
title: Six rank-four theories of finite Paley graphs, with a sharp 29-vertex bound
